methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU-Google AI incubator represents deliberate intervention to build deep capability outside NoVA, but concentrated institutional approach suggests expertise remains hub-bound rather than distributed across the region's workforce.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia signals potential for distributed, locally-owned capability development in economically transitioning regions, moving beyond platform dependence toward authentic skill-building.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Young workforce feeling AI pressure suggests platform-delivered tools creating shallow adoption imperative—workers adapting to AI tools rather than building deep technical capability to shape them.

signals.title: Pentagon Expands Scale AI Deal to $500M and AI Defense Firm TurbineOne Moves HQ to Northern Virginia - Clearance Jobs
signals.signal_reading: Pentagon's $500M Scale AI expansion and TurbineOne HQ relocation to NoVA intensifies defense-AI concentration, reinforcing capital-talent-contract flywheel that widens capability gap with other Virginia regions.

signals.title: Healthcare providers say AI helps them focus on patients. But it also raises questions about privacy, security and the role of humans in medicine
signals.signal_reading: Healthcare providers' widespread AI adoption for administrative tasks indicates shallow, platform-delivered tools achieving broad distribution even in underserved regions, but without deep technical literacy or local development capacity.
